sum: Max Ventures Investments Holdings Private Ltd has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition or shareholding change in Max Financial Services Limited.
detail: Max Ventures Investments Holdings Private Ltd, the holding entity of Max Financial Services' promoter group, submitted a formal disclosure of substantial acquisition under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. This filing is mandatory when a promoter or acquirer crosses defined thresholds (typically 25% for an initial acquisition, or 5% incremental beyond 25%). The disclosure itemises the acquirer's identity, shareholding pattern pre- and post-acquisition, and timing. Depending on the triggering event and exemption claims, an open offer to public shareholders at the highest price paid may follow within prescribed timelines.
